title: Vendedor(a) Pleno
description:
A Schalter busca um profissional com maturidade comercial, capacidade de negociação, repertório consultivo e foco em performance para atuar na venda de soluções tecnológicas, desde a identificação da oportunidade até o fechamento e expansão da carteira.


Fundada em 1991, a Schalter é referência em soluções completas de autoatendimento e self-checkout, com um ecossistema que inclui hardware, software, implantação, suporte técnico on site, monitoramento remoto, locação e outsourcing. Nosso propósito é ajudar nossos clientes a satisfazer seus próprios clientes, com tecnologia, eficiência e inovação.


Esta posição exige capacidade de diagnóstico comercial, condução de reuniões estratégicas, negociação de propostas e desenvolvimento de contas, em uma operação orientada a resultado.


Responsabilidades

●      Prospectar novos clientes e desenvolver novas oportunidades de negócio

●      Realizar reuniões e apresentações comerciais

●      Identificar necessidades e dores dos clientes

●      Apresentar soluções tecnológicas aderentes ao cenário de cada conta

●      Elaborar, conduzir e negociar propostas comerciais

●      Fechar vendas e apoiar a expansão da carteira

●      Manter relacionamento com clientes e stakeholders

●      Atualizar CRM, controles e sistemas internos

●      Atuar em conjunto com áreas internas para garantir fluidez no processo comercial

●      Antecipar riscos e sugerir melhorias contínuas na operação comercial

Requisitos

●      Experiência comprovada em vendas e negociação

●      Vivência com atendimento ao cliente e relacionamento comercial

●      Boa comunicação verbal e escrita

●      Capacidade de negociação e condução de fechamento

●      Organização, planejamento e gestão de pipeline comercial

●      Perfil orientado a metas e resultados


Diferenciais

●      Experiência com venda de soluções tecnológicas

●      Conhecimento em produtos de informática

●      Familiaridade com terminais de autoatendimento, self-checkout e softwares aplicativos

●      Formação em Administração, Marketing, Gestão Comercial, TI ou áreas afins


Remuneração e condições

●      Salário fixo compatível com formação, experiência e escopo do cargo

●      Remuneração variável/comissão conforme performance

●      Benefícios informados ao longo do processo seletivo, conforme política interna da empresa

●      Jornada presencial, em tempo integral, em Cachoeirinha/RS


Se você quer atuar em uma empresa com proposta de valor robusta, venda consultiva e espaço para geração real de resultado, a Schalter quer conhecer o seu perfil.

  • Prática com versionamento de código utilizando Git ;

  • Conhecimento em CI/CD (ex: Jenkins);

O que estamos buscando?


Engenharia de Dados AWS Sênior - ID

Esse vaga precisa de inglês Avançado . title: Vendedor Externo - Advisory
description:
Quem somos nós:

A Skintec é uma empresa referência em tecnologias para medicina estética e bem-estar, com mais de 30 anos de atuação no mercado . Atuamos ao lado de médicos e clínicas que buscam inovação, segurança e resultados consistentes, oferecendo soluções tecnológicas de alto padrão, respaldadas por evidências científicas e certificações internacionais.

Mais do que tecnologia, entregamos suporte especializado, relacionamento de longo prazo e desenvolvimento para nossos parceiros . Nosso time é movido pela Cultura WOW , que valoriza pessoas, excelência e a superação de expectativas.

Skintec — conectando tecnologia, pessoas e excelência médica.


Resumo do desafio:

Realizar venda consultiva, desenvolvendo negócios e gestão de contas, prospectar e realizar a

gestão de carteira de clientes da Skintec, foco em Medical e clientes chave de cada região.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em mercado de luxo e clientes de alto padrão;
  • Vivência anterior com Medical Devices ou corretatos;
  • Forte atuação em negociações de alto ticket e vendas consultivas;
  • Habilidades com CRM.



Condições:

Contratação PJ, estamos trabalhando com pretensões salarias e condições compatíveis do mercado.

title: GTM Builder
description:
GTM builder

You are an AI-native builder. You don’t just use AI tools; you build agents, copilots, and autonomous systems. You understand how modern LLMs actually work: tool use, reasoning loops, structured outputs, retrieval, memory, and orchestration. You are comfortable vibe-coding, shipping fast, and learning new AI tooling weekly. You’ve built side projects, internal tools, or production systems using LLMs, agents, or automation frameworks. You think in systems, not scripts. You’ll be responsible for building A...

You know that the leverage of a single great AI builder today is 10–100x a traditional engineer. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.

You Will:

• Design and deploy autonomous AI agents that can research, reason, and execute real business workflows

• Build agentic systems using modern LLM capabilities including tool use, function calling, structured outputs, and multi-step reasoning

• Create internal AI copilots used daily by marketing, sales and operations

• Implement retrieval systems (RAG) using embeddings and vector databases to give agents context and memory

• Build AI workflows that can enrich accounts, qualify leads, generate insights, and automate execution

• Integrate AI agents deeply into our stack: HubSpot, internal databases, enrichment platforms, and product systems

• Automate workflows that previously required human operational effort

• Build scraping, parsing, and AI extraction systems to convert unstructured web data into structured intelligence

• Rapidly prototype, test, and deploy new AI capabilities as new models and tools become available

• Continuously improve agents to make them faster, smarter, cheaper, and more reliable

• Build reusable internal frameworks, tools, and agent architectures

• Own systems end-to-end — from idea to production

You Have:

• Strong software engineering ability and the ability to ship working systems quickly

• Hands-on experience building with modern LLMs and AI tools (OpenAI, Anthropic, open models, or similar)

• Experience building AI agents, copilots, or automated workflows

• Strong prompt engineering skills and understanding of structured prompting and reliability

• Experience integrating APIs, webhooks, and external systems

• Ability to work with structured and unstructured data

• Experience with automation tools like N8N, Make, Zapier, or similar

• Comfort working with web scraping, enrichment systems, and data pipelines

• Strong builder mindset — you learn fast, experiment fast, and ship fast

• High agency — you figure things out without needing step-by-step instructions

• Curiosity and obsession with new AI capabilities

• Bonus: Experience with vector databases, embeddings, or retrieval systems

• Bonus: Experience building multi-step agent workflows

• Bonus: You actively build AI projects outside of work

• Bonus: You use AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow

title: Analista de Implantação ERP – Módulo Fiscal/Contábil
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.

Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade : Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

title: Senior Go Developer
description:
Senior Go Developer

Brazil

Software Engineer Lead


Important Information


Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a Senior Software Engineer Backend you will be part of a fast-paced, collaborative team developing our attack surface intelligence capabilities. You will be a critical contributor to the development and integration of reconnaissance technologies and products while also moving forward the state of engineering best practices in our cybersecurity platform. If you enjoy pivoting between different problems and meeting new challenges every day while developing solutions that are mission critical to the organization, this role is for you!

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop and integrate cybersecurity testing and analysis systems with best-in-class cybersecurity platform;
  • Build high-performance, resilient, scalable cloud-based software, microservices architecture and containers;
  • Take software through CI/CD all the way to production and own its quality and availability;
  • Utilize GCP platform to build and run highly-available software systems;
  • Identify and resolve performance issues across systems and components;
  • Collaborate on a cross-functional team, working with Product, Operations, and Platform Engineering;
  • Integrate monitoring and alerting capabilities with backend modules to allow proactive improvements to availability and response times;
  • Design, implement and deliver well-tested, scalable, highly available systems;
  • Own and ideate technical solutions for product requirements and user stories;
  • Actively engage and participate in design and code reviews;
  • Offer guidance and support to junior team members, encouraging and cultivating a culture of continuous learning within the team

Essential Skills


  • Experience in distributed-systems and backend software engineering;
  • Strong Golang Required;
  • Strong experience and understanding of microservices, REST API design, gRPC, unit testing, BDD testing;
  • Strong design skills required – UML is a bonus; exposure to Domain Driven Design desirable;
  • Experience with asynchronous messaging technologies such as Google PubSub, Kafka;
  • In depth knowledge of NoSQL and RDBMS technologies;
  • Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud Environments (GCP preferred);
  • Experience working on agile teams;
  • Experience developing scalable and observable microservice-based applications
  • Experience with GitOps and DevOps principles, practices and tools;
  • A proven ability to thrive in a collaborative environment involving different stakeholders and subject matter experts
  • Advanced English skills.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Interest in security / penetration testing;
  • Interest in GenAI and LLM technologies.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Senior Software Developer (.NET)
description:
Se você gosta de construir aplicações robustas, manja de boas práticas, curte trabalhar com arquitetura limpa e quer evoluir em um time que valoriza engenharia, colaboração e aprendizado contínuo, essa oportunidade é pra você!


Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?


Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Habilidades Técnicas:

- .NET Core Apis;

- Micro-serviços;

- SQL Server;

- xUnit (Testes unitários);

- Git;

- RabbitMQ;

- Metodologia ágil (Scrum).


Diferenciais:

- Kafka;

- Docker;

- CI/CD.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Gympass - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Automotive Account Manager
description:
What you’ll do


  • Manage and develop assigned customer accounts and ensure achievement of sales, profitability, and performance targets.
  • Prepare and negotiate quotations for RFQs, costing and pricing, ensuring alignment with agreed margin levels.
  • Identify and win new profitable business within the account.
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships and support company image.
  • Monitor market trends and competitor activities to identify new opportunities.
  • Analyse profitability and implement appropriate actions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional collaboration with customers to resolve issues efficiently, enhance satisfaction, and drive company targets.
  • Develop sales strategies, plans, and budgets for customer accounts.
  • Track business opportunities, reporting , and account performance.
  • Support team development, define KPIs, and monitor performance.
  • Improve sales and quotation processes and ensure efficient operations.


Your profile


  • Degree in business, engineering, or a related field.
  • Min. 3 years of experience in B2B sales management in automotive environment.
  • Understanding of the wire harness products and market is a strong plus.
  • A confident communicator with strong negotiation and relationship-building skills.
  • Customer-focused with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
  • Analytical thinker with the ability to turn insights into actions.
  • Self-driven, with the ability to take initiative and lead cross-functional collaboration.
  • Professionally resilient and adaptable to the market changes and challenges.
  • Proactive, with a growth mindset and results‑driven approach.
  • A team player who thrives in a dynamic, international environment.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Brazilian).


What we offer


  • A dynamic, international environment where your impact truly matters.
  • Real ownership of accounts and the opportunity to shape customer strategy.
  • Career growth opportunities and the chance to develop leadership skills.
  • Collaboration with global teams and leading industry customers.
  • Competitive compensation, benefits package & company car.

title: Desenvolvedor Infra-as-Code Multi-Cloud Pleno (Remoto)
description:
Olá!


A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios . Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.


Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering , Data Analytics , Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.


Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados. Increase the power of your business .


Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:


❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir automações para provisionamento e gerenciamento de infraestrutura;
  • Implementar e manter Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) utilizando Terraform;
  • Criar playbooks e roles com Ansible para automação de configuração e padronização de ambientes;
  • Desenvolver scripts e soluções para automação operacional utilizando Python, PowerShell e Shell Script;
  • Integrar sistemas e plataformas por meio de APIs REST;
  • Automatizar processos e fluxos em ambientes VMware, com foco em vRealize (vRA / vRO);
  • Atuar em conjunto com times de infraestrutura, cloud, segurança e desenvolvimento para garantir ambientes escaláveis, seguros e resilientes;
  • Documentar automações, processos e boas práticas.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Experiência sólida com Terraform;Conhecimento prático em Ansible;
  • Experiência com programação e automação em Python;
  • Desenvolvimento de scripts em PowerShell e Shell Script (Bash);
  • Experiência no consumo e criação de APIs REST;
  • Vivência com ambientes VMware, especialmente vRealize Automation (vRA / vRO);
  • Conhecimento em sistemas Linux e Windows Server.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:

  • Colaboração para atuação com múltiplos times (infraestrutura, cloud, segurança e desenvolvimento);
  • Organização e disciplina para documentação de processos e boas práticas;
  • Proatividade para automação e melhoria contínua de ambientes;
  • Capacidade analítica para resolução de problemas;
  • Autonomia na condução de demandas técnicas;
  • Adaptabilidade;
  • Colaboração;
  • Foco no cliente;
  • Visão de dono.


❇️ Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com pipelines CI/CD;
  • Conhecimento em cloud (Oracle OCI, Azure e AWS);
  • Vivência com práticas de DevOps e Git;
  • Experiência com monitoramento e observabilidade;
  • Certificações em cloud (OCI e AWS).

title: DevOps Consultant
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais, somos GPTW.

♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

DevOps Pleno


Responsabilidades

Projetar e manter soluções de monitoramento e telemetria para aplicações e infraestrutura.

Implementar e gerenciar Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics e Container Insights.

Criar dashboards, alertas e relatórios personalizados para acompanhamento de performance.

Implementar observabilidade em ambientes serverless (Azure Functions, Logic Apps e App Services).

Monitorar ambientes Kubernetes / AKS com coleta de métricas, logs e rastreamento distribuído.

Automatizar provisionamento de recursos de observabilidade utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Bicep ou ARM).

Definir e acompanhar SLO, SLI e SLA para aplicações críticas.

Integrar ferramentas de monitoramento com pipelines de CI/CD.

Implementar e acompanhar métricas DORA (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time, MTTR e Change Failure Rate).


Requisitos Técnicos

Azure Monitor

Application Insights

Log Analytics

Container Insights

Observabilidade em ambientes Azure

Kubernetes / AKS

Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Bicep ou ARM)

Integração com pipelines DevOps (CI/CD)

Azure Functions e Azure Logic Apps

Monitoramento de performance de aplicações (APM)

Métricas DORA e indicadores de confiabilidade


Formato de trabalho: Remoto

title: Consultor(a) Dataviz SR
description:
Consultor(a) sênior para liderar soluções de visualização de dados com Power BI, integrado à stack AWS, atuando com times globais.


Principais atividades:

  • Projetar e evoluir dashboards e relatórios no Power BI com foco em clareza, consistência e performance.
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio em visualizações e métricas (DAX/Power Query), definindo padrões e governança de dataviz.
  • Integrar e operacionalizar dados na AWS (ex.: S3, Athena/Glue, Redshift) para consumo no Power BI.
  • Conduzir apresentações e workshops com stakeholders globais, promovendo insights acionáveis.


Requisitos:

  • Sênior em dataviz/BI com domínio de Power BI (DAX, M, modelagem tabular, otimização).
  • Experiência prática na stack AWS aplicada a dados/analytics.
  • Forte base em SQL, modelagem de dados e boas práticas de design de visualização.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente para participar de reuniões com times globais.


Informações adicionais:

  • Atuação remota
  • Contratação CLT

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.


THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.



What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.


Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.


Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.


By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.


OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Senior Backend (Node.js) Engineer
description:
About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


About The Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer , you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions , creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate .


What You’ll Do:

  • Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to:
  • AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows
  • OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents
  • Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile
  • Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes
  • Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere
  • Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture.
  • Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability.


What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript.
  • Strong experience with Node.js
  • Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices.
  • Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Nest.js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services.
  • Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications.
  • Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management.
  • Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.g., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies.
  • Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling.
  • Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Why Join XILO?

  • A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact
  • Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale
  • Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Clinical Study Manager
description:
Job Summary

The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.


Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities

  • Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials.
  • Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required.
  • Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects.
  • Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines.
  • Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies.
  • Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation.
  • In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.g., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required.
  • Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials.
  • Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable.
  • Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively
  • Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions.
  • Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable.
  • Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product.
  • Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead.
  • Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans.
  • Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.e. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation.
  • Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report.
  • Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites.
  • Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required
  • Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct
  • Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated
  • Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives.
  • Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed.
  • Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.


Education and Experience

  • Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management.
  • Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.g. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.).
  • Experience managing clinical project team personnel.
  • Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies.
  • Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations.
  • Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process.
  • Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US.
  • Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members.
  • Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers.
  • Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate.
  • Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment.
  • Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment.
  • Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).
  • .
  • Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers.
  • Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business.
  • Must be fluent in English

title: [Tech] Engenharia de Software Backend Sênior - Java
description:
Descrição da vaga

Atuar em equipe ágil no desenvolvimento e sustentação de produtos digitais, entregando valor de forma contínua e com qualidade, utilizando boas práticas de engenharia de software, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e a estabilidade das soluções em produção.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, colaborando para manter um ambiente saudável e produtivo entre os membros da equipe;
  • Desenvolver e evoluir os produtos com foco em qualidade, utilizando testes automatizados e realizando revisões de código entre pares (code review);

  • Realizar deploy em ambiente de produção utilizando processos de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD), garantindo a estabilidade da aplicação;
  • Propor melhorias técnicas e participar ativamente da evolução da arquitetura dos sistemas;
  • Garantir a segurança e a qualidade das entregas, respeitando os padrões estabelecidos pela equipe;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com áreas parceiras (DevOps, QA, Produto) na busca por soluções robustas e escaláveis.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior completo ou cursando na área de Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Programação orientada a objetos (POO);

  • Vivência com atuação em times ágeis e em ambientes de alta disponibilidade.

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Vaga Analista Devops Pleno


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:




Desenvolver e apoiar iniciativas de automação e inovação, identificando oportunidades de melhoria contínua nos processos.

Implementar, manter e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD, garantindo qualidade e agilidade nas entregas.

Atuar na gestão e provisionamento de infraestrutura em nuvem (AWS), aplicando boas práticas de segurança, escalabilidade e performance.

Administrar e sustentar ambientes de containers (Docker/Kubernetes), promovendo melhorias contínuas.

Apoiar projetos de migração para cloud, contribuindo com análises técnicas, mapeamento de riscos e execução das atividades.

Monitorar ambientes e aplicações, atuando na identificação e resolução de incidentes e gargalos.

Realizar troubleshooting de nível 2, garantindo estabilidade e confiabilidade dos ambientes.

Participar de discussões técnicas e de arquitetura, contribuindo com recomendações e boas práticas.


HABILIDADES E COMPETÊNCIAS


Conhecimentos intermediários em sistemas operacionais (Linux e Windows Server).

Experiência com linguagens de programação/scripting (Python, .NET, JavaScript ou similares).

Vivência com cloud (AWS) e infraestrutura como código (Terraform ou similares).

Conhecimento em ferramentas de CI/CD e versionamento (GitHub ou similares).

Experiência com containers e orquestração (Docker/Kubernetes).

Conhecimentos em monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas e APIs.

Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.

Senso crítico e foco em resolução de problemas.

Postura colaborativa e orientação a resultados.

title: Senior NodeJS Developer
description:
Senior Node.js Developer

Location: Brazil (preferred)

Contract / Contract-to-Hire | Immediate Start

We’re looking for a Senior Node.js Developer to join a fast-growing engineering team working on regulated financial platforms across LATAM.


This is an urgent, high-impact hire. You’ll be joining at a critical stage, helping to deliver key product milestones and scale secure, high-availability systems in a regulated environment.

If you enjoy ownership, autonomy, and building systems that genuinely matter - this role is for you.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building and scaling backend services using Node.js
  • Deploying and managing applications in Kubernetes
  • Working with MongoDB in production environments
  • Contributing to cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS)
  • Identifying technical risks and proactively solving them
  • Collaborating closely with product and engineering stakeholders


What We’re Looking For

  • 5–8+ years of backend development experience
  • Strong commercial experience with Node.js (essential)
  • Experience with Kubernetes and containerised environments
  • Solid knowledge of MongoDB
  • Experience with Azure or AWS (nice to have)
  • Comfortable working in regulated or high-availability environments


More importantly, we’re looking for someone who:

  • Takes ownership
  • Communicates clearly
  • Thinks ahead and manages risk
  • Works independently
  • Thrives in fast-paced teams


Experience in Financial Services, Open Finance, or Banking is a plus.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Salesforce)
description:
About us

First Line Software works with some of the world's top businesses and organizations across industries such as healthcare, real estate, data engineering, warehouse automation, retail digitalization, mobile app development, and e-commerce.

Our projects are as diverse as our people — and we believe in building software through collaboration, transparency, and shared success.

Let's see what we can create together!


About the project

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer (Salesforce) to join a long-term project and support the improvement of deployment processes across multiple systems, including Salesforce and web applications .

In this role, you will work closely with an existing DevOps setup and client-side leadership, contributing to automation, reliability, and efficient delivery pipelines. This is a hands-on position for someone who enjoys improving workflows, reducing manual effort, and working independently within a collaborative environment.


Responsibilities

  • Drive improvements in deployment workflows across Salesforce and other applications, reducing manual steps and increasing reliability
  • Design and implement CI/CD pipelines , including solutions tailored for Salesforce
  • Improve and maintain version control practices to ensure traceability and safe rollbacks
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to strengthen DevOps culture and best practices
  • Support release management, monitoring, and environment stability (SRE-related tasks)
  • Ensure security and compliance standards are followed across deployments
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve automation, performance, and delivery processes


Requirements

  • Strong experience with DevOps practices and process improvement
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce DX, SF CLI, and Developer Tools , including deployments and configurations
  • Experience building and optimizing CI/CD pipelines (YAML/JSON), preferably with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (ARM templates, Bicep, or Terraform)
  • Solid experience working with Azure (App Services, KeyVault, Azure SQL, Storage Accounts, VNet)
  • Nice to have: exposure to AWS or GCP
  • Scripting skills in PowerShell and/or Bash
  • Strong understanding of version control systems (Git or similar)
  • Experience supporting release management and monitoring (SRE concepts)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work independently in a distributed team


What we can offer

The FLS difference

  • Our modern stack projects are the right mix of exciting and challenging
  • Gain access to our diverse range of training programs, courses, and certifications
  • Choose your work style - remote, on-site or hybrid in one of our stunning offices.
  • Enhance your language skills with our corporate English classes
  • Work from anywhere and explore the world with our Workation program

title: SRE - Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de uma pessoa SRE Pleno. Essa pessoa atuará no time de MLOps, responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, escalabilidade e eficiência da infraestrutura que suporta os modelos e pipelines de Machine Learning em produção. Trabalhamos em um ambiente colaborativo, com forte cultura de engenharia e incentivo ao desenvolvimento contínuo. Tudo isso em uma empresa líder no mercado brasileiro de farmácia, referência em Saúde e Bem-estar com mais 3.000 lojas em todos os estados brasileiros.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Responsabilidades:


  • Implementar e manter infraestrutura como código utilizando Terraform, seguindo padrões e boas práticas já estabelecidos pelo time.
  • Operar e dar manutenção em clusters Kubernetes, utilizando Helm e práticas de GitOps para suporte à entrega contínua de aplicações.
  • Atuar na operação do dia a dia de ambientes AWS, contribuindo para a disponibilidade e estabilidade das plataformas.
  • Apoiar o diagnóstico de problemas de rede em cloud providers, atuando em conjunto com membros mais sêniores do time em cenários mais complexos.
  • Manter pipelines de CI/CD com GitLab, colaborando com times de desenvolvimento e dados.
  • Acompanhar e utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog) para identificar anomalias e apoiar a resposta a incidentes.
  • Participar de processos de resposta a incidentes e post-mortems, contribuindo com análises e implementação de melhorias.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de FinOps, auxiliando na identificação de oportunidades de otimização de custos na nuvem.


Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos Técnicos


Obrigatórios


  • Experiência prática com Terraform para gerenciamento de infraestrutura como código.
  • Conhecimento sólido em AWS.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Kubernetes, incluindo uso de Helm e fluxos GitOps.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em GitLab (pipelines, CI/CD, repositórios).
  • Capacidade de diagnóstico em redes em ambientes cloud (VPC, security groups, DNS, load balancers, etc.).
  • Bom domínio de Linux e administração de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana e Datadog.


Diferenciais:


  • Conhecimento introdutório de práticas de FinOps em ambientes cloud.
  • Experiência ou interesse em ambientes de MLOps ou Data EngineeringPerfil comportamental
  • Boa capacidade de resolução de problemas e raciocínio analítico, com vontade de evoluir em cenários de infraestrutura e sistemas distribuídos.
  • Comunicação clara e facilidade para trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Perfil com senso de dono, proativo e aberto a aprender com o time.

Essa pessoa atuará no time de MLOps, responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, escalabilidade e eficiência da infraestrutura que suporta os modelos e pipelines de Machine Learning em produção. Trabalhamos em um ambiente colaborativo, com forte cultura de engenharia e incentivo ao desenvolvimento contínuo. Tudo isso em uma empresa líder no mercado brasileiro de farmácia, referência em Saúde e Bem-estar com mais 3.000 lojas em todos os estados brasileiros.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Responsabilidades:


  • Implementar e manter infraestrutura como código utilizando Terraform, seguindo padrões e boas práticas já estabelecidos pelo time.
  • Operar e dar manutenção em clusters Kubernetes, utilizando Helm e práticas de GitOps para suporte à entrega contínua de aplicações.
  • Atuar na operação do dia a dia de ambientes AWS, contribuindo para a disponibilidade e estabilidade das plataformas.
  • Apoiar o diagnóstico de problemas de rede em cloud providers, atuando em conjunto com membros mais sêniores do time em cenários mais complexos.
  • Manter pipelines de CI/CD com GitLab, colaborando com times de desenvolvimento e dados.
  • Acompanhar e utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog) para identificar anomalias e apoiar a resposta a incidentes.
  • Participar de processos de resposta a incidentes e post-mortems, contribuindo com análises e implementação de melhorias.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de FinOps, auxiliando na identificação de oportunidades de otimização de custos na nuvem.


Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos Técnicos


Obrigatórios


  • Experiência prática com Terraform para gerenciamento de infraestrutura como código.
  • Conhecimento sólido em AWS.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Kubernetes, incluindo uso de Helm e fluxos GitOps.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em GitLab (pipelines, CI/CD, repositórios).
  • Capacidade de diagnóstico em redes em ambientes cloud (VPC, security groups, DNS, load balancers, etc.).
  • Bom domínio de Linux e administração de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana e Datadog.


Diferenciais:


  • Conhecimento introdutório de práticas de FinOps em ambientes cloud.
  • Experiência ou interesse em ambientes de MLOps ou Data EngineeringPerfil comportamental
  • Boa capacidade de resolução de problemas e raciocínio analítico, com vontade de evoluir em cenários de infraestrutura e sistemas distribuídos.
  • Comunicação clara e facilidade para trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Perfil com senso de dono, proativo e aberto a aprender com o time.

title: Estagiário
description:
A Sherwin-Williams é uma empresa multinacional americana do segmento de tintas e revestimentos e está em busca de um Estagiário para atuar na Engenharia de Projetos da unidade de Sumaré.


Atividades:

  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento e acompanhamento de projetos de investimento (CAPEX) do site;
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de escopos técnicos, cronogramas e orçamentos;
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento com as áreas (Manutenção, Processo e Produção, EHS);
  • Abertura de Requisições de compra para os projetos;
  • Follow-up com Compras e Fornecedores;
  • Acompanhar a execução dos Projetos em campo;
  • Conduzir pequenos projetos de CAPEX seguindo a metodologia.


Requisitos:

  • Cursando a partir do 2º ano (4º semestre) de Engenharia Mecânica;
  • Inglês Intermediário;
  • Pacote Office Intermediário;
  • Desejável conhecimento em Excel e MS Project;
  • Desejável conhecimento em AutoCAD, SolidWorks e similares;
  • Será considerado um diferencial ter conhecimento em Desenhos Técnicos;
  • Será considerado um diferencial já ter atuado na área de Projetos;
  • Disponibilidade para estagiar presencialmente em Sumaré;.


Informações da vaga:

  • Benefícios: Bolsa auxílio, Assistência Médica e Odontológica, Seguro de vida, Refeição no local, Vale transporte e Gympass.


Se você se identifica com esta posição e está em busca de novos desafios, inscreva-se!

title: Engenheiro de software sênior
description:
Desenvolvedor Sênior C/C++ – Meios de Pagamento e TEF


Descrição da vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior com sólida experiência em C/C++ e profundo conhecimento em meios de pagamento, especialmente em TEF (Transferência Eletrônica de Fundos). O(a) profissional atuará no desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções de pagamento, integrando POS, pinpads e sistemas de adquirência, com foco em desempenho, segurança e alta disponibilidade.


  • Responsabilidades: Desenvolver e manter aplicações em C/C++ voltadas para meios de pagamento e TEF.
  • Implementar e manter integrações com adquirentes, gateways e dispositivos de automação comercial.
  • Atuar na análise e resolução de problemas técnicos em ambientes de missão crítica.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de segurança e mensageria em transações financeiras.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com times multidisciplinares (QA, produto, infraestrutura).


  • Requisitos obrigatórios: Experiência comprovada com desenvolvimento em C e/ou C++.
  • Sólida vivência com TEF e meios de pagamento.
  • Experiência com integração de POS, pinpads e automação comercial.
  • Conhecimento em protocolos de comunicação (TCP/IP, porta serial).
  • Conhecimento prático da norma ISO 8583 (mensageria para transações financeiras).
  • Experiência com banco de dados Oracle (consultas, procedures).
  • Familiaridade com sistemas operacionais Linux e/ou Windows embarcados.
  • Uso de ferramentas de versionamento (ex: Git).


  • Desejável: Conhecimento em Java e/ou Node.js para suporte a integrações ou serviços complementares.
  • Experiência com criptografia e segurança da informação.
  • Noções de desenvolvimento embarcado ou ambientes de tempo real.
  • Vivência com testes automatizados e pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Experiência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Fullstack Sênior com ampla experiência em Java e Angular para integrar nossa equipe. O candidato ideal deve ter forte conhecimento técnico e habilidades para desenvolver soluções inovadoras e de alta qualidade.



Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web utilizando Java (Spring, Spring Boot, JSF, EJB, JPA) e Angular.

  • Primavera

  • Angular JS

description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


Please note that we're aiming at an expatriation to Portugal


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria , as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a “Lifetime Experience ” where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you need to have

  • College degree in IT, Computer Science, or similar;
  • 4+ years of experience Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE configuration, customization, and development;
  • Strong proficiency in C# and .NET Framework;
  • Experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI) for plugin development, workflows, and system jobs;
  • Hands-on experience with relational databases (design, SQL, tuning);
  • Familiarity with Web APIs (SOAP/REST);
  • Experience with Azure DevOps;
  • Excellent English skills (C1/C2);


Nice to have

  • Knowledge of JavaScript and web technologies for front-end development;

  • Will to exceed expectations (your own and the ones defined by Affinity);
  • Exceptional skills and the will to acquire more;
  • Autonomy, proactivity, and focus (even under pressure);
  • Obsession for doing things right, and ability to prioritize;
  • Versatility (you can be a fan of BYOD or not);
  • Ability to innovate and evolve in a market in constant mutation.


What will encourage you

  • Being part of a company that has a disruptive action in the technology market;
  • Being part of a technology focused on relationships, simplicity, and efficiency;
  • Accessing a generative career directly proportional to your performance and interest;
  • The real possibility of being part of our company staff.

title: Salesforce Consultant
description:
Job Title: Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst


Introduction: We are seeking a highly skilled Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst with 7 to 10 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role is pivotal in optimizing and managing our Salesforce ecosystem, driving business growth through effective CRM solutions. The ideal candidate will leverage their expertise in Sales Cloud , application administration , integration , and AI-led automation to enhance user experience, streamline processes, and deliver actionable insights. This position plays a critical role in aligning Salesforce capabilities with organizational goals, ensuring seamless collaboration across departments and maximizing CRM value.


Roles and Responsibilities:


  • Lead the administration and configuration of the Salesforce Sales Cloud platform to support business processes and user requirements.
  • Design, develop, and implement integrations between Salesforce and third-party systems to ensure data consistency and process automation.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Manage and optimize Salesforce application administration tasks including user management, security roles, profiles, workflows, and validation rules.
  • Drive AI-led automation initiatives within Salesforce to enhance sales productivity and decision-making using tools such as Einstein Analytics and AI-driven workflows .
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement enhancements to maintain optimal CRM functionality.
  • Develop training materials and conduct user training sessions to promote adoption and effective use of Salesforce features.
  • Stay current with Salesforce releases, features, and best practices to continuously improve system capabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with IT, sales, marketing, and customer service teams to ensure Salesforce supports cross-functional business needs.

Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 7 to 10 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Systems Analyst or Administrator with a focus on Sales Cloud .
  • Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Certified Administrator , Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant , or equivalent are highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience in application administration, configuration, and customization of Salesforce environments.
  • Proven expertise in integrating Salesforce with external applications using APIs, middleware, or integration platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of AI-led automation tools within Salesforce, including Einstein Analytics and process automation capabilities.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively across teams.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and project management is a plus.

Tools and Technologies:


  • Salesforce Sales Cloud
  • Salesforce Application Administration (User Management, Security, Workflows, Validation Rules)
  • Salesforce Integration Tools (APIs, REST/SOAP, Middleware like MuleSoft, Dell Boomi)
  • AI-led Automation Tools (Salesforce Einstein, Einstein Analytics, AI-driven Process Automation)
  • Data Management and Reporting tools within Salesforce
  • Familiarity with Agile project management software (e.g., Jira, Confluence)

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Pleno Dynamics 365
description:
Especialistas em tecnologias e plataformas para gestão para negócios, somos reconhecidamente, uma das principais provedoras de soluções Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM no Brasil.

Com foco na inovação e comprometidos com a qualidade, nossos projetos já ajudaram muitas empresas a mudarem o futuro das pessoas.

Nossa cultura está baseada em entregar inovação e criatividade com alta performance trazendo para o time, profissionais que possuam espírito inovador, alma empreendedora e obsessão em evoluir.

Então, vamos realizar juntos?


Estamos em busca de um talento com foco em desenvolvimento, customizações, automações e integrações em Dynamics 365 / Power Platform.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver customizações e extensões em Microsoft Dynamics 365;
  • Atuar com Dataverse, Power Automate e Power Apps;
  • Desenvolver e manter plugins, workflows e integrações;
  • Apoiar tecnicamente o time funcional na implementação das soluções;
  • Garantir aderência às boas práticas Microsoft e padrões Bizapp;
  • Participar de testes, correções e estabilização da solução.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência prática com Microsoft Dynamics 365;
  • Conhecimento em Dataverse;
  • Desenvolvimento com C# (plugins) e JavaScript;
  • Experiência com Power Automate e Power Apps;
  • Vivência em projetos de CRM ou soluções corporativas.


Competências Comportamentais:

  • Organização e senso de responsabilidade;
  • Boa comunicação com times técnicos e funcionais;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes com múltiplas demandas;
  • Compromisso com prazos e qualidade de entrega.


Nossos benefícios:

  • Cartão benefício Flash com vale refeição de R$30,00/dia;
  • Parceria com instituições de ensino para graduação e especializações;
  • Assistência médica e odontológica sem coparticipação;
  • Incentivo para educação (idiomas);
  • Aplicativos de saúde e bem-estar;
  • Parceria com o SESC;
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto;
  • Treinamentos e Certificação;
  • Avaliação de desempenho e feedback 1:1


Na Bizapp apoiamos a igualdade de gênero, cor, idade, orientação sexual, crença e deficiência. Por isso, todos os candidatos são considerados igualmente em nossos processos.

title: Arquiteto de Aplicações Pré-Vendas
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Análise técnica e identificação de riscos contratuais;
  • Estruturação de propostas técnicas e comerciais de alto valor;
  • Precificação estratégica para contratos de grande porte;
  • Realizar levantamento e entendimento de requisitos técnicos junto aos clientes, com foco em desenvolvimento e sustentação de aplicações;
  • Atuação em RFPs e processos licitatórios;
  • Interface com múltiplos níveis hierárquicos;
  • Criação e precificação de soluções tecnológicas de alto valor financeiro, em contratações públicas;
  • Criação e apresentação de soluções tecnológicas com escopo de Aplicações;
  • Apresentação de soluções para clientes internos e externos;
  • Negociação com fornecedores externos para cotação que façam parte da solução a ser criada.


Requisitos

  • Experiência em arquitetura e soluções de Aplicações (desenvolvimento e sustentação de aplicações, metodologias ágeis, pontos de função, dentre outros)
  • Conhecimento sólido em Arquitetura de aplicações (monolíticas, microsserviços, APIs, dentre outros.), integração de sistemas, modelos de sustentação, DevOps e CI/CD e Cloud
  • Experiência em estimativas técnicas (pontos de função, homem-hora, UST, HST).
  • Conhecimento prático (mesmo que não atual) de linguagens de desenvolvimento (Java, .NET / .NET Core, Node.js, Python, dentre outros).
  • Análise de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais.
  • Definição de premissas, riscos e dependências técnicas.
  • Experiência na utilização e aplicação de IA em soluções desenvolvimento e sustentação de aplicações;
  • Experiência em defesa técnica de soluções tecnológicas para clientes internos e externos;
  • Conhecimento de leis e legislações aplicáveis para contratações públicas;
  • Capacidade de análise crítica e mitigação de riscos;


Diferenciais

  • Experiência na função atuando em órgãos governamentais;
  • Conhecimento de normas legais que regem contratações de serviços de desenvolvimento e sustentação de aplicações para o governo federal;
  • Experiência na leitura e interpretação de editais;
  • Inglês e/ou Espanhol para conversação com equipes internacionais;
  • Leitura e interpretação de editais extensos;
  • Conhecimento e atuação em oportunidades ou projetos de transformação digital.
  • Atuado em Pré-Vendas com propostas inovadoras com IA.


Informações adicionais:

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação HÍBRIDA caso seja das seguintes regiões: São Paulo / Rio de Janeiro / Brasília / Porto Alegre / Belo Horizonte / Fortaleza
  • Caso contrário, atuação remota

description:

  • Implementar e configurar módulos de ITOM: Discovery, Event Management, Orchestration, Service Mapping, Cloud Management.

  • Desenvolver e manter scripts, workflows e automações utilizando Flow Designer e Script Includes.

  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de infraestrutura, segurança e desenvolvimento para garantir a eficácia das soluções.
  • Participar de projetos de transformação digital e automação de processos operacionais.

  • Formação Superior Completo.
  • Experiência com ServiceNow, especialmente nos módulos de ITOM.
  • Conhecimento avançado em CMDB, CI Classes, relacionamentos e normalização de dados.
  • Domínio de JavaScript para desenvolvimento na plataforma.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e integração via APIs REST/SOAP.
  • Certificações desejáveis:
  • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – ITOM
  • ServiceNow System Administrator
  • ITIL Foundation

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Senior Oracle Project Manager – Oracle ERP & Legacy Ecosystems


We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead complex, high-impact initiatives across Oracle ecosystems and legacy systems . This PM is focused on managing strategic improvement programs, regulatory adaptations (including Brazilian Tax Reform), system updates, enhancements, testing cycles, and the delivery of new functionalities in enterprise environments.


The ideal candidate demonstrates a proactive, dynamic, and ownership-driven mindset , with strong systemic and strategic vision, the ability to anticipate risks, and proven experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder projects.


Required Experience & Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Senior Project Manager in complex enterprise IT environments.
  • Strong background managing projects within Oracle ecosystems (Oracle EBS ERP and related solutions) and legacy systems .
  • Solid experience leading large-scale improvements, regulatory compliance initiatives, system upgrades, and testing programs .
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex stakeholder landscapes and executive-level communication.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end systems integration and dependency management .
  • Experience in environments with high regulatory and operational complexity .
  • Excellent leadership, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end project management for complex initiatives involving Oracle platforms and legacy systems .
  • Manage projects related to system improvements, regulatory adaptations (e.g., Tax Reform), upgrades, updates, testing cycles, and new functionality rollouts .
  • Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, IT teams, vendors, and executive leadership .
  • Drive governance, planning, execution, monitoring, and control of multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Anticipate risks, issues, and dependencies, proactively proposing mitigation strategies and corrective actions.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives, regulatory requirements, and technology solutions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional and multicultural teams, including internal teams, subcontractors, and partners.
  • Oversee scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk management.
  • Deliver clear, concise project communication, status reports, executive presentations, and decision papers.
  • Support strategic planning, roadmap definition, and prioritization of initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate governance, security, quality, and audit requirements.


Desired Profile

  • Proactive and dynamic professional with a strong sense of ownership .
  • Strategic mindset with strong systemic vision .
  • Ability to anticipate issues and risks before they materialize .
  • Results-driven, resilient, and adaptable to changing priorities.
  • Strong decision-making capability and accountability.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous and high-pressure environments.


Contract & Work Model

  • PJ (contractor) model
  • Long-term engagement: 1 year, renewable
  • Primarily remote, with sporadic national travel as needed

description:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead complex, high-impact initiatives across Oracle ecosystems and legacy systems . This PM is focused on managing strategic improvement programs, regulatory adaptations (including Brazilian Tax Reform), system updates, enhancements, testing cycles, and the delivery of new functionalities in enterprise environments.


The ideal candidate demonstrates a proactive, dynamic, and ownership-driven mindset , with strong systemic and strategic vision, the ability to anticipate risks, and proven experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder projects.


Required Experience & Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Senior Project Manager in complex enterprise IT environments.
  • Strong background managing projects within Oracle ecosystems (Oracle EBS ERP and related solutions) and legacy systems .
  • Solid experience leading large-scale improvements, regulatory compliance initiatives, system upgrades, and testing programs .
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex stakeholder landscapes and executive-level communication.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end systems integration and dependency management .
  • Experience in environments with high regulatory and operational complexity .
  • Excellent leadership, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end project management for complex initiatives involving Oracle platforms and legacy systems .
  • Manage projects related to system improvements, regulatory adaptations (e.g., Tax Reform), upgrades, updates, testing cycles, and new functionality rollouts .
  • Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, IT teams, vendors, and executive leadership .
  • Drive governance, planning, execution, monitoring, and control of multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Anticipate risks, issues, and dependencies, proactively proposing mitigation strategies and corrective actions.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives, regulatory requirements, and technology solutions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional and multicultural teams, including internal teams, subcontractors, and partners.
  • Oversee scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk management.
  • Deliver clear, concise project communication, status reports, executive presentations, and decision papers.
  • Support strategic planning, roadmap definition, and prioritization of initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate governance, security, quality, and audit requirements.


Desired Profile

  • Proactive and dynamic professional with a strong sense of ownership .
  • Strategic mindset with strong systemic vision .
  • Ability to anticipate issues and risks before they materialize .
  • Results-driven, resilient, and adaptable to changing priorities.
  • Strong decision-making capability and accountability.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous and high-pressure environments.


Contract & Work Model

  • PJ (contractor) model
  • Long-term engagement: 1 year, renewable
  • Primarily remote, with sporadic national travel as needed

title: Senior .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Contractor)

Job Type: Full-time (Remote)

Pay: R$20,000.00 – R$22,000.00 per month


Resume:

English version only.

Highlight SAAS projects, healthcare related projects, and HIPAA experience.

Highlight experiences in .NET MVC and .NET Maui


Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer contractor to join our U.S.-based team remotely. You will leverage your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects.

In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to our Agile workflow via Azure DevOps . You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews , expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. Your role will evolve based on your strengths and our needs — all while adhering to rigorous coding and security standards .


Key Responsibilities

1. Product Design & Development

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to design software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancing existing codebases (opportunities starting around months 3–4).

2. Testing & Quality

  • Design and implement automated End-to-End (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability — with a strong focus during your first 6–9 months.

3. Peer Reviews & Post-Release Support

  • Participate in pre-release feature reviews (ongoing).
  • Conduct initial post-release bug ticket analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.

4. Agile Collaboration

  • Actively contribute to 2-week sprints and 6-week release cycles (3 sprints per release).
  • Participate in sprint planning, pull requests, releases, and daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT).

5. Communication & Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members across time zones.


Qualifications

Experience

  • 8 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record on complex projects.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Application (.NET 8) for mobile and web development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
  • Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with healthcare software or Protected Health Information standards (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Experience with pull request reviews and sprint participation.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: 2-week sprints, 6-week release cycles, daily stand-ups at 3:00 PM CT.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tools: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and more.
  • Team Culture: Accountability, quality, and excellence in delivery.
